text.en: This Order may be cited as the Merchant Shipping (Amendment) Order, of section 13 of S 27/02.

Section 13 of the Merchant Shipping Order, 2002 is amended{a) by deleting the sub-heading and by substituting "Registration and tonnage fees." therefor; {b) in subsection (2), by deleting "tax" from the first line and by substituting "fee" therefor; {c) in subsection (3), by deleting "tax" from the first line and by substituting "fee" therefor; {d) by deleting subsection (4);

(e) in subsection (5), by deleting "and tonnage taxes" from the first line; {f) in subsection (6), by deleting "fee or annual tonnage tax" from the and by substituting "registration or annual tonnage fees" of S 62/06.

The Merchant Shipping (Registration of Ships) Regulations, 2006 are

(a) in regulation 5

(i) in paragraph (a), by inserting "and" immediately after

(ii) in paragraph (b), by deleting "; and" and by substituting a fullstop therefor; [iii) paragraph (c);

(b) in regulation 34(c), by deleting "tax" from the last line and by substituting "fee" therefor;

(c) in regulation 35 -

(i) in the sub-heading, by deleting "tax" and by substituting "fee"

(ii) in paragraph (a), by deleting "tax" from the first line and by substituting "fee" therefor. Made this 2nd. day of Jamadilawal, 1430 Hijriah corresponding to the 27th. day of April, 2009 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM

AWANG HAJI MAT DAUD BIN AWANG HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percctakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
